messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick quarterly OKR sync — sharing a compact status: shipped vs slipped vs action items. brief replies pls.
Diego Ramos: Thanks — sending owner + dep list shortly. Main ask: can infra team own the model routing fallback by EOW? @Marta
Marta Nguyen: I can take routing fallback, but need a small config spec and one extra test GPU. filing infra ticket.
Diego Ramos: filed ticket #4521, added test hardware note. ETA 3 days. pinging @Eli for qa plan.
Eli Chen: QA can do smoke + perf checks; will need sample prompts and expected latency SLOs. please paste sample harness snippet.
Aisha Patel: sample harness:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-7b", "prompt":"<sample>"}'
```
Expect p95 < 200ms on dedicated in PROD.
Marta Nguyen: noted. also we slipped on the model quantization milestone — estimate 2-week delay due to kernel tuning regressions.
Diego Ramos: that's ok, prioritize routing fallback first. Can we mitigate with temporary routing to larger instance? @product-ops any budget concerns?
product-ops: Temporary route to larger instances approved for up to 48 hours; ops will monitor cost and alert if trend exceeds threshold :eyes:
Aisha Patel: next steps: (1) Marta owns routing fallback (ticket 4521) (2) Eli owns QA harness and perf checks (3) Diego owns rollback/playbook for canary (4) Product to rescope quantization milestone — propose new date in 48h.
Diego Ramos: I'll draft rollback playbook and drop in this thread. few questions inline — where do we store canary traces? s3 or datadog?
Eli Chen: put traces in s3 bucket rwd-qa-traces and forward metrics to datadog for dashboards. I'll create the dashboard.
Aisha Patel: thanks team. small ask — code review pings: if you touch routing, add `// owner: Marta` in PR description so we can auto-assign. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for canary window 2026-04-15T16:00Z -> 2026-04-15T20:00Z. CI will run smoke + perf.
Marta Nguyen: ack, I'll start on config spec today. will update ticket and link PR when ready.
Diego Ramos: ack, will follow up with rollback doc by EOD tomorrow.
Aisha Patel: perfect. If anything stalls, @mentions here. thanks all :sparkles:
